description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeRouterInterface via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeRouterInterface spec.

interconnectAttachmentRef.description: The InterconnectAttachment this interface belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `ComputeInterconnectAttachment` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

ipRange.description: Immutable. The IP address and range of the interface. The IP range must be in the RFC3927 link-local IP space. Changing this forces a new interface to be created.

privateIpAddressRef.description: The private IP address assigned to this interface. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeAddress resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/addresses/{{addressID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/addresses/{{addressID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeAddress resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeAddress resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

redundantInterfaceRef.description: The interface the BGP peer is associated with. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeRouterInterface resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/routers/{{routerID}}/interfaces/{{interfaceID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeRouterInterface resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeRouterInterface resource.

region.description: Immutable. The region this interface's router sits in. If not specified, the project region will be used. Changing this forces a new interface to be created.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

routerRef.description: The router this interface belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeRouter resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/routers/{{routerID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeRouter resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeRouter resource.

subnetworkRef.description: The subnetwork this interface belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeSubnetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/subnetworks/{{subnetworkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

vpnTunnelRef.description: The VPNTunnel this interface belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `selfLink` field of a `ComputeVPNTunnel` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

title: GCP Compute ComputeRouterInterface
